import pandas as pd

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_health_care_employment.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
start_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Health care support occupations', na=False)].index[0]
support_df = df.iloc[start_idx + 1:50].dropna(subset=[0]).copy()
support_df[14] = pd.to_numeric(support_df[14], errors='coerce')
top3 = support_df.sort_values(by=14, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].tolist()
